title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Samantha Li
description: Add a set of RAG agent templates (playbooks) and tool-calling examples plus corresponding quickstart pages on the docs site. Motivation: provide engineers with reusable RAG templates and concrete tool-calling examples to accelerate prototyping and reduce onboarding friction for integrations that use external tools (search, SQL, calendar). This PR includes: - RAG templates: browser-search, sql-runner, calendar-assistant (templated prompts + example harnesses). - Tool-calling examples: Node/TS and Python quickstarts demonstrating structured tool output, function calling in streaming, and fallback to non-tool mode. - Docs site: quickstart pages, TOC entries, and small screenshots for the playbook playground. - Tests: unit tests for template rendering and example harness smoke tests. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and example code - [x] Docs pages + TOC updates - [x] Add smoke tests and CI job - [x] Link Linear ticket ENG-2145 and support case SUP-3321 - [x] Address reviewer feedback and fix broken links CI notes: initial CI had a flakey lint rule failure (mdx-lint) which was fixed by applying the prettier config and re-running the job. All checks are passing on the final run. Notes for reviewers: focus on examples/clarity, security (no secrets in examples), and whether the quickstarts make it straightforward to get a working RAG flow in < 15 minutes. Related PRs: redwood-examples PRs that add reference apps (see PRs in redwood-examples).
